item.title: [NEWS] THE ETERNAL STRUGGLE FOR SURVIVAL IN TX2'S NEW VIDEO - 'I AM THE ENEMY' IS A SURPRISINGLY MATURE TREATISE ON OPPRESSION
item.dc:creator: Mighn Taghor
item.description:
At first glance, TX2's new music video for 'I Am The Enemy' seems to play purely with absurdity. Beneath the low-budget costumes, however, lies a poignant allegory colliding the raw naturalism of nature docs - think hatchling sea turtles massacred by seagulls - with the traumatic aesthetic of the Normandy landings. The beach becomes a battleground for the right to exist, forcing a defenseless outcast to abandon the role of the victim just to stay alive.

The video seamlessly weaves a classic 'Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles' trope into this brutal realism. Cornered and hunted, the young creature is forced to master combat to survive. It serves as the ultimate visual counterpart to the track itself, where Evan Thomas dissects the mechanics of alienation: when the world denies you the right to live on your own terms, simply fighting to survive automatically brands you as 'the enemy' in the eyes of society.

This symbolism peaks inside the bunker, where the protagonist comes face-to-face with the ruthless Crab Commander. This grotesque figure is the literal embodiment of a rigid system, representing the song's 'tradition and authority.' Clad in a hard shell of conformity and an officer's cap, the crab never gets his own claws dirty in the sand - he deploys his seagulls to pacify anyone trying to reach the ocean. When he finally removes his cap to reveal a medieval flail hidden underneath, the message hits with crystal clarity: behind the facade of rules and social order, there is always raw violence. Through a deceptively simple, campy lens, TX2 delivers a stark reminder that against a soulless system, refusing to be a victim is the only way out.

Source: YouTube Official Music Video

item.title: [INFORMATION] Editorial Notice: Zero Cheap Drama and Baseless Accusations
item.dc:creator: Mighn Taghor
item.description: We know the internet loves cheap drama and pulled-out-of-thin-air accusations about TX2, but you will not find any of that here. We don't farm clicks at the expense of someone else's reputation, and we don't recycle garbage dug up from the darkest corners of the web. We only post verified updates along with solid fan theories and deep dives taken with a grain of salt. Zero hate, zero slander - let's just respect ourselves and each other. Read more about our ethos in the project guidelines.

item.title: [NEWS] TX2 Unleashes New Single 'I AM THE ENEMY' Ahead of Video Premiere
item.dc:creator: Mighn Taghor
item.description:
It is officially out - TX2's new single 'I AM THE ENEMY' has hit streaming platforms (bundled digitally as a two-track drop alongside 'Witch Hunt'). Speaking to the press, Evan Thomas explained the track was written from a place of owning who he is in a world where his identity stays under constant scrutiny, adding that if his refusal to change makes him a villain, he has no issue wearing the crown. That unapologetic punk punch sets a fierce tone ahead of the 2027 European club run and the Warsaw show at Hydrozagadka - browse the full release catalog in our discography.

Source: Kerrang! / Rock 'N' Load

item.title: [NEWS] New Collab Drop: TX2 Guests on Bailey Spinn's 'silent anymore'
item.dc:creator: Mighn Taghor
item.description:
On November 13, rising alt-rock vocalist Bailey Spinn dropped her heaviest sophomore record to date, 'death & devotion' (via AWAL), featuring TX2 on track #8, 'silent anymore'. Sharing guest billing with Kellin Quinn (Sleeping With Sirens), The Funeral Portrait, and Melrose Avenue, Evan Thomas and crew bring gritty crossover weight to the track while already fueling social feeds with unhinged nurse-costume Shorts alongside Bailey on YouTube and X. Marking another sharp link-up with female voices in modern heavy alt-rock following DeathbyRomy on 'Feed', this drop keeps momentum rolling before the upcoming tour dates and joins the catalog tracked in our discography.

Source: Rock 'N' Load / idobi

item.title: [NEWS] Rumor Confirmed: 'Seagulls and Crab Commander' Is the Official 'I AM THE ENEMY' Video Plot
item.dc:creator: Mighn Taghor
item.description:
Remember our recent rumor about seagulls and a Crab Commander from an LA casting sheet? We now have solid confirmation it was no casting troll - it is the actual storyline for the 'I AM THE ENEMY' music video premiering on YouTube on November 17 at 9:00 PM CET. Backstage production listings tie the track title directly to 'Crab Leader' and 'Seagull Soldier' roles in a plot about a turtle seeking revenge for a D-Day-style seagull beach invasion, while the YouTube premiere artwork already shows a soldier in a WWII helmet and a strapped-on turtle shell screaming amid beach explosions. Once again, TX2 blends combat intensity with B-movie camp absurdity - dive into the roots of this aesthetic in our wtf TX2 overview.

Source: YouTube Premiere / Backstage

item.title: [NEWS] Tour Check: Zero Cancellations, Locked Rockville Date, and Milan Venue Mismatch
item.dc:creator: Mighn Taghor
item.description:
We audited TX2's official tour widget alongside the November 13 press routing: zero shows were cancelled, postponed, or newly added over the past week. Both the North American 'Not Broken Enough Tour' with Catch Your Breath (hitting New Haven tonight through December 5 in Oklahoma City) and the February-March 2027 EU/UK headlining leg - including Warsaw's Hydrozagadka stop - remain locked in, with fresh low-ticket warnings flagged across most UK and European dates. Two key details stand out: TX2's Welcome to Rockville 2027 slot is now pinned to Sunday, May 9, while the official Bandsintown widget still lists Milan (Feb 26, 2027) at Santeria Toscana 31 despite local promoter ticketing already pointing to Lime Club Milano - track every confirmed stop in our tour schedule and check the Warsaw fan action on our main page.

Source: TX2 Official Tour / Rock 'N' Load

item.title: [RUMOR / THEORY] Theory / Debate: 'We Need Punk Back' in 'I AM THE ENEMY' - Sincere Manifesto or Calculated Rage-Bait?
item.dc:creator: Mighn Taghor
item.description:
The 'WE NEED PUNK BACK' tagline attached to 'I AM THE ENEMY' alongside a fresh batch of Shorts ('Am I punk or a poser?') has reignited heated debates across Reddit and TikTok. Detractors on alternative boards dismiss the anti-authority hooks as recycled clichés chasing viral clicks, while longtime fans argue Evan Thomas is deliberately leaning into self-aware provocation - baiting the 'poser' comments to hijack platform algorithms ahead of the November 17 video drop and next year's European run. Dig deeper into how this polarization works in our wtf TX2 guide.

Source: YouTube Shorts @TX2OFFICIAL / Reddit

item.title: [RUMOR / THEORY] Rumor: Are the Bailey Spinn Clips Just 'silent anymore' Promo or a Hint at 2027 Live Crossovers?
item.dc:creator: Mighn Taghor
item.description:
Following the release of 'silent anymore', fans noticed a string of joint comedic promo clips from TX2 and Bailey Spinn hitting X and YouTube Shorts over the November 14-15 weekend, right as Spinn teased major 2027 plans in her heavier era post-Scene Queen tour. Comment sections immediately started speculating whether the duo might team up live at upcoming US festivals or future 2027 tour runs. So far there is zero official word from either camp - read how we separate fun fan theories from verified facts in our project guidelines.

Source: X @tx2official / YouTube Shorts

item.title: [NEWS] TX2 Sets 'I Am The Enemy' Video Premiere for November 17
item.dc:creator: Mighn Taghor
item.description:
The guesswork surrounding the follow-up to 'WITCH HUNT' is officially over. TX2's official YouTube channel has locked in the video premiere countdown for 'I Am The Enemy' on November 17, 2026 at 9:00 PM. The premiere thumbnail confirms the military rumors: Evan sits in full combat gear and a vintage helmet on an open beach, teasing an amphibious retro assault.

Source: YouTube @TX2OFFICIAL

item.title: [RUMOR / THEORY] Seagulls and Crab Commander: Casting Troll or Surrealist TX2 Video?
item.dc:creator: Mighn Taghor
item.description:
Backstage casting leaks from the Los Angeles video shoot (directed by Evan Thomas and Cameron Rostami) read like total fever-dream absurdity. Instead of gritty combat realism, Discord and Reddit communities are buzzing about a D-Day seagull beach assault, a vengeful turtle, and costumed sea creatures serving under a 'Crab Commander'. While some fans welcome a return to campy B-movie satire from Evan's early days, others suspect a calculated misdirection campaign to guard the real storyline.

Source: r/poppunkers (Reddit)

item.title: [NEWS] Not Broken Enough Tour Midway: 11 Tracks Crushed Into 35 Minutes
item.dc:creator: Mighn Taghor
item.description:
Hitting Atlanta's Tabernacle on November 8 alongside Catch Your Breath, TX2 has solved the live setlist equation. Packing 11 songs (starting with 'Infamous' and closing on 'I Would Hate Me Too') into an unforgiving 35-minute support window requires brutal discipline: zero dead air between tracks, seamless beat-matched transitions, and trimmed second verses to prioritize massive choruses and crushing breakdowns. If this nonstop adrenaline carries over to the European run, Warsaw is in for absolute mayhem - check out the fan campaign on our main page.

Source: AXS Tabernacle / Setlist.fm

item.title: [NEWS] No-Brakes Rock Cruise: TX2 Officially Confirmed for ShipRocked 2027
item.dc:creator: Mighn Taghor
item.description:
It is official: TX2 will make their sea debut during the 17th annual ShipRocked festival cruise, sailing January 24-30, 2027 from Miami toward Honduras and Mexico aboard the Carnival Horizon. Evan Thomas and the band share billing with rock heavyweights including Papa Roach, Ice Nine Kills, Nothing More, and Magnolia Park. Ahead of their Caribbean voyage, explore the band's full touring itinerary and lineup breakdown.

Source: ZRock Magazine ShipRocked Announcement

item.title: [RUMOR / THEORY] TikTok vs Radio Veterans: Can ShipRocked Handle the TX2 Aesthetic?
item.dc:creator: Mighn Taghor
item.description:
The ShipRocked lineup reveal sparked a wave of heated debates across veteran cruise message boards. The festival's core audience leans heavily toward traditional 2000s post-grunge and classic hard-rock fans. Online discussions are clashing over whether TX2's aggressive trap-metal/emo energy and chaotic moshpits will win over the older crowd, or if the maritime run will face conservative skepticism toward a 'TikTok band'. Check out our community values and inclusivity charter in the project guidelines.

Source: ShipRocked Community Discussions

item.title: [NEWS] 'Witch Hunt' Hits 400k Views - Fuel for Conflict, Not an Online Truce
item.dc:creator: Mighn Taghor
item.description:
Expectation: A defiant anti-cyberbullying anthem shuts down online detractors, puts trolls in their place, and runs up mainstream pop millions. Reality: Crossing 400k views on YouTube is a respectable metric for an independent alternative drop, but the comments remain a vicious combat zone. Evan's polarized image feeds the platform algorithms, turning the track into fresh ammunition for both camps rather than an internet ceasefire. Check out the band's discography.

Source: YouTube - TX2 'Witch Hunt' Official Video

item.title: [NEWS] California Sellouts - Grabbing Spotlight in a Tight 30-Minute Support Slot
item.dc:creator: Mighn Taghor
item.description:
Expectation: TX2 conquers the West Coast as a conquering arena headliner packing venues in Sacramento and Santa Ana. Reality: TX2 is locked into an undercard slot on the Not Broken Enough Tour, sharing support duties alongside Arankai and Colorblind before Catch Your Breath. The win here is not headlining prestige, but hitting early stage times with relentless 30-minute aggression to hijack the main act's audience before the night even peaks. Explore their full tour history.

Source: TX2 Merch - Official Tour Schedule

item.title: [RUMOR / THEORY] Gothic Inquisitions vs Gritty European Basements (Warsaw 2027)
item.dc:creator: Mighn Taghor
item.description:
Expectation: Viral buzz across Discord and Reddit bets on TX2 bringing lavish Halloween theatricality and witch-trial stage production to their 2027 European club dates. Reality: Routing through grassroots venues - including Warsaw's Hydrozagadka on February 20, 2027 - means cramped brick cellars, tight stage clearance, and zero budget for theatrical sets. If the European run hits, it will be carried strictly by loud overdrive, raw sweat, and moshpit density, not stage props. Join the fan campaign on our main page.

The set is rumored to revive deeper cuts from the Cruel World EP and Ghost of LA, alongside potential stripped-down acoustic bridges. Check out the band history and discography.
